metadata.description: Marketplace interno da consultoria: plugin ABAP (MCP na Cloudflare), agentes de clientes e o stack padrão de engenharia.

plugins.name: abap
plugins.description: Conecta o Claude ao ABAP (plataforma de serviços da consultoria): projetos de clientes, 14 atividades de governança, modelos (diagnóstico, organograma, fluxo), Drive e planilha, pelo MCP hospedado na Cloudflare.

plugins.name: agent-engineering
plugins.description: A playbook for coding agents: plan changes, implement with checks, review independently, and publish within your limits.

plugins.name: agent-handoff
plugins.description: Strict 3-stage handoff workflow (plan → execute → verify) for coding agents. Disk-backed state enables fresh-context code review and multi-stage verification across chat contexts. Supports multi-phase plans and parallel subagent execution.

plugins.name: ai-firstify
plugins.description: AI-first project auditor and re-engineer based on the 9 design principles and 7 design patterns from the TechWolf AI-First Bootcamp

plugins.name: backend-design
plugins.description: Teaches Claude the reflexes of a senior backend engineer. Workflows, disciplines, and opinionated defaults for data modeling, migrations, queries, idempotency, error handling, observability, performance, security, authentication and authorization, debugging, and testing. Covers APIs, workers, CLIs,

plugins.name: cowork-plugin-management
plugins.description: Create, customize, and manage plugins tailored to your organization's tools and workflows. Configure MCP servers, adjust plugin behavior, and adapt templates to match how your team works.

plugins.name: customer-support
plugins.description: Triage tickets, draft responses, escalate issues, and build your knowledge base. Research customer context and turn resolved issues into self-service content.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Streamline engineering workflows — standups, code review, architecture decisions, incident response, and technical documentation. Works with your existing tools or standalone.

plugins.name: expo
plugins.description: Official Expo skills for building, deploying, upgrading, and debugging Expo apps

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Official GitHub MCP server for repository management. Create issues, manage pull requests, review code, search repositories, and interact with GitHub's full API directly from Claude Code.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

plugins.name: prisma
plugins.description: Prisma MCP integration for Postgres database management, schema migrations, SQL queries, and connection string management. Provision Prisma Postgres databases, run migrations, and interact with your data directly.

plugins.name: senior-engineering-partner
plugins.description: A strict code reviewer, pair programmer, debugger, and mentor for Python, Bash, Google Apps Script, and JavaScript — a security-first, phase-aware engineering discipline with an enforced spec → plan → TDD → verify workflow.
